**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Innes](../persons.html#744)
If you look at the notice at p. 499 of the May no and 599 of the June you will see the fees as to questions fully explained.

In fact I do not know what more there is to say about them.[^1]
[Bishop Jenner](../persons.html#758) has carefully looked over the [Prayer book Lessons](../books.html#202) and returned them to me and I am going over them with his criticisms.

Half is quite ready if you want it for the printers.
I should much prefer having a sum at once- say[ £50 for the first thousand](../others.html#160), and then a royalty on what afterwards sold
In the last number of the [Packet](../others.html#52) ‘Early Recollections’ are by
[Mrs Brougham](../persons.html#207)
Castlehaven Rectory,
Castle Townsend
Co Cork
I think you have the others

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
The One Grief is by
[Miss E Bussell](../persons.html#232)
St James’ Parsonage
Dingwall

[^1]: These were fees for participating in the preparation for the English Literature part of the Cambridge Local Examination.
